yt_title: Every night at 3 AM, the power goes out in this town. Part 1 #shorts

scenes.text: Every night at three A.M., the power in Alder Creek goes out. For exactly one hour.
Population: nine hundred. Nobody here talks about it.
scenes.name: ALDER CREEK

scenes.text: You moved in last week. You thought it was just old wiring.
Then, at two fifty-eight, your phone buzzes.
scenes.title: Message

scenes.text: You look through the peephole. There's no one there.
Your phone lights up again. Same number.
scenes.title: Message
